title: Law to require construction waste disposal plans
summary: This bill would require permit applicants for new construction, alterations and demolition to submit a construction waste management and disposal plan to the Department of Buildings, identifying licensed haulers, disposal facilities and estimated waste amounts. Before signing off on a permit, DOB, together with the Department of Sanitation and Department of Environmental Protection, would have to verify compliance with the plan. Failure to comply could result in a minimum $1,000 civil penalty and possible suspension or revocation of contractor licenses for repeated violations.
